title: Official Addon Contract Smoke Provider Hardening
problem: After the cross-repo official addon refactor, the remaining near-term risks are local task envelope mirrors, live smoke repeatability, and provider descriptor ownership.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper bulk task routes manifest --no-fail-fast
PowerShell parser checks for smoke scripts
live smoke when local Nako server/admin token are available
cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper provider registry manifest config --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Confirmed ADR 0033 already records Addon Protocol version/release separation. Opened follow-on lane for task envelope unification, live smoke hardening, and provider descriptor boundary while deferring official sidecar packaging splits.

Removed metadata scraper local Addon Task envelope mirrors and switched bulk route/planner code to public nako-addon-protocol AddonTaskRequest/AddonTaskResponse types. Focused task/route/manifest tests, fmt, and diff checks passed.

Hardened official smoke scripts with explicit Nako-path guards, writeback outcome assertions, manifest task declaration checks, and E2E preflight mode. Parser checks, preflight, guard proof, focused Rust tests, and diff checks passed; full live Docker/server smoke was not executed.

Moved provider catalog entries into provider modules and made manifest provider schema/secret reference generation consume registry-derived descriptors. Focused provider/registry/manifest/config tests, full package tests, fmt, and diff checks passed.
Closed workstream with residual live smoke and official addon-family install-boundary follow-ons recorded.

non_goals: splitting official metadata addon into many user-installed sidecars
Nako product process supervision for sidecars

continue_policy.notes: Core lane is complete. Future work should open separate lanes for full live Docker/server smoke execution or official addon-family packaging/install UX decisions.
